limits: Games share starting rosters, game seeds and league selection, but changed plays alter future calls, fatigue, RNG consumption and snap populations. They are outcome guards, not paired causal experiments.
Only official non-nullified called run/pass scrimmage rows enter play denominator; called-run YPC excludes pass-call scrambles. YAC requires a field-bearing completed nonintercepted pass.
Concept/front/coverage rates reflect generated players and playcalling; no NFL population calibration. MissingYBC is an absent contact field, not an automatically proved no-contact play.
Game scores and long tails are not physical-force calibration targets.
